questions.question: In the story of Daniel and the lions' den, a decree said no one could pray to any god or man for thirty days except whom?
After the king signed a decree against praying to anyone but him, what did Daniel do?

answers.text: He kept praying just as he had before
He stopped praying for thirty days
He prayed only in secret at night

questions.question: After a night in the lions' den, Daniel said God sent what to shut the mouths of the lions?
Why were no wounds found on Daniel when he was lifted out of the lions' den?

answers.text: He had trusted in his God
The king's seal had kept him safe
He had stayed awake all night
